structured_output.what_is_happening: I rate this a likely rug with close to no runner chance. It's a copycat token called "Ondo Finance" (ONDO) on PumpSwap, 42 minutes old. It uses the real Ondo Finance brand, X handle and website (https://ondo.finance/), and the logo image is duplicated 65 times across tokens. The trigger was $5.7M of volume in one hour on about $60k of liquidity, which is 95x turnover. GeckoTerminal counts 1,765 unique buyers against only 51 unique sellers, with 4.5k buys and 2.4k sells. Buyers and sellers that lopsided look like volume bots or wash trading, not organic demand. One unlabeled wallet (FhVo3...) holds 80% of supply. The pool holds only about 12.8%, so the circulating float is tiny and a huge overhang can be dumped into a thin pool. The same-name pairs from the same wave are already dead ($0.3 liquidity). The news hook is real: Ondo launched BlackRock-backed portfolios on 2026-09-24. But it belongs to the real ONDO token, not this one.
